A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same LRC work and complete 33-page material, including Appendices A–E. Text and visual inspection support reliable comparison; pages 3–33 are identical.

before.justification: v2 reports original evaluations of trained LRC models, component ablations, efficiency measurements, and supplementary experiments in Appendix E.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and the two-seed experiment in Appendix E.8.

M1.justification: Low-rank weight projection, activation cloning, alignment reuse, training losses, and deployment procedures remain identical in Section 3 and Appendices C–D.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training corpora and evaluation coverage, including general language benchmarks, factual QA, safety/honesty, and instruction-following tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main and appendix experiments, including Sheared-Llama, Minitron, TinyBERT, Qwen3, and the other SLM baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices D–E retain identical training budgets, model configurations, preprocessing, metrics, zero-shot and five-shot protocols, and ablation settings.

E4.justification: Component and layer ablations, neuron masking, data-quality comparisons, quantization, loss-weight sensitivity, and projection-structure analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix E.8 and Table 20 already report LRC-1.5B runs with seeds 218 and 42 in v2 and remain identical in v3. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All result entries, numerical values, and plotted trends are retained. For example, Table 1 reports the same average scores of 64.98 for LRC-1.7B and 63.17 for Qwen3-1.7B.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Equations 1–4, Lemma 1, its proof in Appendix A, and the scalability argument in Appendix B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning unified projection and cloning, competitive SLM performance, and training-token efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of FFN knowledge transfer, SFT and few-shot behavior, and projection structure are retained. Limitations concerning larger-scale training and unchanged FFN intermediate dimensions also remain identical.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, and resource information are unchanged. The abstract's new 'Huggingface' hyperlink targets the same LRC-4B-Base address printed in v2, making this a presentation edit.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, and positioning relative to feature-based distillation, hard pruning, and other compression approaches are unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 updates the first author's email and version/date header, and replaces the abstract's printed checkpoint URL with 'Huggingface'. There is no substantive prose rewriting or section reorganization.

P2.justification: Shorter link text and hyperlink styling reflow pages 1–2 and shift Figure 1 upward. In v3, an introduction line overlaps the final line of Figure 1's caption; v2 has no such overlap. Remaining displays and layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The scientific content and appendices are unchanged. v3 makes the existing checkpoint address clickable, but introduces overlapping introduction and Figure 1 caption text on page 1. This localized readability loss outweighs the small navigation benefit.
